language.description: Primary Language. If not set, set to NONE.

timezone.description: Primary Time Zone. If not set, set to GMT.

orgDisabled.description: Specifies whether an organization's information is disabled. This field is disabled by default.

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription

status.description: The status of the subscription indicating whether it is on trial, expired and disabled, not subscribed, subscribed, or temporarily extended.

state.description: The current state of the subscription indicating whether it is active, expired, disabled, or not started.

licenses.description: The number of licenses owned by the tenant under the subscription. The license could be for users, Virtual Service Edges, proxy ports, NSS feeds, etc.

startDate.description: The subscription start time in Unix time format

strStartDate.description: The subscription start date in MM/DD/YYYY format

strEndDate.description: The subscription end date in MM/DD/YYYY format

endDate.description: The subscription end time in Unix time format

sku.description: The ID of the service enabled through the subscription

cellCount.description: Specifies the number of cells that can contain data when a template is uploaded to the Advanced Data Protection tool

updatedAtTimestamp.description: The timestamp in Unix time format when the subscription was last updated

subscribed.description: A Boolean value indicating that the subscription is active or is not started
